history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration develop an action plan to continue to promote adaption and integration in order to facilitate the efficient achievement of the “whole-of- pillar” approach.
history.administration_response: It should be noted that the previous OIOS recommendation on strengthening management culture and communication in the Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs has been fully implemented and is now considered closed. The peace and security pillar consists of the Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs and the Department of Peace Operations, thus the Executive Office takes a “whole-of- pillar” approach to providing administrative, financial, budgetary and human resources guidance and support to both Departments. To facilitate continued adaption and integration and to avoid fragmentation, the Executive Office supports the efficient achievement of the pillar’s goals by ensuring that administrative guidance and support are provided to all offices, regardless of whether an office is in the Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs or the Department of Peace Operations, are consistent across the pillar and are in line with existing policies, rules and regulations.
history.board_assessment: Given that the staff survey of the Secretariat in 2023 has not been conducted, the Board consider this recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration develop an action plan to continue to promote adaption and integration in order to facilitate the efficient achievement of the “whole- of-pillar” approach.
history.administration_response: The Secretariat-wide staff engagement survey (SES), led by the Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance, was postponed from 2023 to 2024. As at 20 March 2024, according to the Department’s Office of Human Resources, it is anticipated that the next staff engagement survey will be launched in September 2024. There is no anticipated date for the availability of results. However, following the results of the 2021 staff engagement survey, the Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs and the Department of Peace Operations developed an action plan to respond to staff concerns, namely the Building our Pillar action plan. The action plan, which is regularly reviewed and updated, focuses on issues that were rated by staff of the Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs and the Department of Peace Operations as lower than the rest of the Secretariat in the 2021 staff engagement survey. The Building Our Pillar initiative continues to provide staff with guidance, resources and opportunities in response to concerns highlighted by staff in the 2021 survey. In view of the implementation and regular update of the reform implementation plan and the Building Our Pillar Action plan, both of which promote adaptation and integration to facilitate the efficient achievement of goals of the “whole-of-pillar” approach, the administration requests closure of the recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given the development of the action plan to promote adaption and integration to facilitate the efficient achievement of goals of “whole-of-pillar” approach, the Board considers this recommendation to be implemented.
